name: terminal-legibility
description: Agent Skill that makes terminal/TUI coding-agent sessions scannable. Audits and sets up a legible theme + font, readable git diffs (delta/difftastic/bat), glamorous markdown rendering (glow/gum), and agent verbosity — then applies a self-formatting output style that leads with the next action and ends with Next Actions + Reflective Questions.
author: Roshan Abraham
